mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_dish WHERE meal_type = #{mealType} AND status = 1 ORDER BY dish_date DESC
SELECT *, (total_stock - sold_count) AS remaining_stock FROM t_dish WHERE DATE(dish_date) = DATE(#{dishDate}) AND meal_type = #{mealType} AND status = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_dish (dish_name, meal_type, dish_date, price, total_stock, sold_count, threshold, status, create_user_id, create_time) VALUES (#{dishName}, #{mealType}, #{dishDate}, #{price}, #{totalStock}, #{soldCount}, #{threshold}, #{status}, #{createUserId}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_dish SET sold_count = #{newSoldCount} WHERE dish_id = #{dishid}
UPDATE t_dish SET total_stock = #{newTotalStock} WHERE dish_id = #{dishid}

UPDATE t_dish SET dish_name = #{dishName}, meal_type = #{mealType}, dish_date = #{dishDate}, price = #{price}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, threshold = #{threshold}, status = #{status} WHERE dish_id = #{dishid}
UPDATE t_dish SET status = #{status} WHERE dish_id = #{dishid}
